posts.title: Different hostname behind a link: red flag or harmless?
posts.description: A link whose text shows one hostname but goes to another is not always phishing. When a different domain is a red flag and when it is harmless, how Reveal URLs decides to flag it at the registrable-domain level, and why domain age is an extra signal to weigh.

posts.title: Scanned a QR code? Check the web address first
posts.description: A QR code hides where it takes you. How to read the web address before you open it, spot lookalike domains and fake stickers on parking meters and menus, and why you should not sign in or pay through a QR link you cannot verify.

posts.title: Upgrading PHP and your server stack with AI, safely and fast
posts.description: PHP2Shell showed what outdated PHP, Node.js or Python costs. Here is how I use AI to upgrade servers and applications quickly, even from PHP 5 or 7, without cutting corners.
